market_context.key_catalyst: Israel-Iran tensions, Hormuz transit risk elevated
market_context.edge_summary: Massive positive edge on Major Disruption (+18.3%) and Super Spike (+8.3%)

trades.name: 100/130 Bull Call Spread
trades.reasoning: Best risk-adjusted trade. Captures all three upside scenarios with 80% win probability. The 100 strike gives delta exposure below current spot, while the 130 cap limits cost. Massive positive EV of $14.50 on $6.50 risk (2.23x). Profits in Major Disruption ($23.50), Super Spike ($23.50), and Moderate Escalation ($8.50).

trades.name: 110 Strike Naked Call
trades.reasoning: Highest absolute EV ($33.50) and best EV/risk ratio (3.53x). Pure convexity play on tail scenarios. Profits massively in Major Disruption ($35.50) and especially Super Spike ($95.50). Lower win probability (60%) but exceptional risk-reward. Use WTI for better liquidity.

trades.name: 120/150 Bull Call Spread
trades.reasoning: Pure tail risk play focusing on Major Disruption and Super Spike. Higher strikes mean lower cost ($5.30) with excellent payoff ratio (4.66x). Max profit in both scenarios ($24.70). Good complement to Trade #1 - this goes deeper OTM for higher leverage.

trades.name: 1x2 Call Ratio Spread 130/180
trades.reasoning: Creative structure targeting Major Disruption sweet spot ($155 mid). Low cost ($3.80) with max profit at 180 ($21.20). The ratio spread profits most in Major Disruption ($21.20), less in Super Spike ($11.20) as price moves through the short strikes. Best payoff ratio (5.58x) but requires active management above $180.

trades.name: 150/180 Deep OTM Call Spread
trades.reasoning: Pure Super Spike lottery ticket. Cheapest entry ($3.20) with massive payoff (8.38x) if we get extreme scenario. Only profits in Super Spike ($26.80) where Brent hits $180-$250. Small position (2%) given low probability (25%) but extraordinary asymmetry. Classic tail risk trade.

risk_management.stop_loss: None - defined risk structures, hold to expiry or target

profit_targets.trade_1: Take 50% off at 2x cost, ride rest
profit_targets.trade_2: Take 50% off at 3x cost, ride rest for convexity
profit_targets.trade_3: Hold to expiry or roll up if Major Disruption occurs
profit_targets.trade_4: Exit if Brent approaches $180 to avoid short gamma

scenario_adjustments.if_major_disruption_occurs: Roll Trade #1 and #3 up and out, take partial profits
scenario_adjustments.if_de-escalation: Close all positions for salvage value, reassess
scenario_adjustments.if_current_state_persists: Hold through expiry, small loss acceptable given edge

key_insights.primary_edge: Market severely underpricing Major Disruption (35% AI vs 16.7% market = +18.3% edge)
key_insights.combined_upside_probability: 60% AI probability for Brent >$130 (Major Disruption or Super Spike) vs 33.3% market implied
key_insights.vol_environment: Elevated IV (~45%) but still underpricing tail risk given geopolitical setup
key_insights.catalyst_timing: 60-90 day window optimal - captures potential escalation without excessive theta decay

execution_notes.liquidity: Use CL (WTI) for Trade #2 due to better liquidity. COIL (Brent) for others as it's direct exposure to Middle East premium
execution_notes.timing: Enter over 2-3 days to avoid moving market, especially on wider spreads
execution_notes.fills: Use limit orders, target mid-market or better given edge size
execution_notes.alternatives: If spreads too wide, consider calendar spreads (buy Dec, sell Sep) to reduce cost
